parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Core/Tests/CoreTests/HTTPURLResponseValidationTests.swift. The two methods — successStatusCodesDoNotThrow (line 19) and nonSuccessStatusCodesThrow (line 32) — are complementary test cases that verify opposite sides of the same HTTP status-code validation contract. Their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8) is expected: both iterate over a set of status codes and assert a specific throwing/non-throwing outcome, but they encode distinct, intentional test scenarios that must remain separate to preserve test-failure locality and readability. Merging or extracting them would obscure which contract is violated when a test fails.
